description: This file defines a PHP controller class `RequestResetWeakPasswordController` responsible for handling password reset requests involving weak passwords, including validation, CSRF protection, and redirection logic in the OrangeHRM system.
external_methods: // The code calls various methods from these external classes, e.g., getUserService(), getContainer(), getCsrfTokenManager(), getPasswordStrengthService(), getAuthUser(), getI18NHelper(), getLogger(), handleBadRequest(), redirect(), generate()

classes.name: RequestResetWeakPasswordController
classes.description: Controller for handling password reset requests with weak password enforcement, including validation, CSRF protection, and user feedback within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process password reset requests, validate inputs, check CSRF token, verify reset code, authenticate user, and enforce password change.

methods.name: validateParameters
methods.description: Validates the request parameters such as username, reset code, password, and current password, including password strength validation.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Constructs and returns a collection of validation rules for request parameters.
